# Contract role: Research analyst, coastal sensor study (Harbor Lights Institute)

Harbor Lights Institute (a fictional nonprofit) is looking for an independent research analyst for a
12-week study. We run 40 low-cost water-level sensors along the Marrow Bay shoreline and want to know
whether they are accurate enough to replace two of our three reference tide gauges.

What you'll do:
- Clean and align 18 months of sensor data (CSV exports, 10-minute readings) with the reference gauges.
- Design and run calibration experiments (drift, temperature effects, biofouling).
- Write a findings report and a 30-minute briefing for the board.

Budget: fixed fee, paid in three milestones. Remote. Start as soon as possible.
